name: MISLEAD MIST
source:
A mysterious beauty named Mist appears before Takuo, a heartbroken 2D-obsessed guy. A hilarious, sad, and exciting erotic romantic comedy unfolds in the alternate dimension she invites him to!

[Translated from TAKERU Press 1995-8/9]
translation:
一位名叫“雾”的神秘美女出现在了心碎的2D痴迷者拓夫面前。一场搞笑、悲伤、令人兴奋的色情浪漫喜剧在她邀请他进入的另一个维度中展开！

[译自TAKERU Press 1995-8/9]
